Mongrain · Wix HTML embed

Foundation Systems page

Live preview of the embed, the full code to paste into Wix, and the three setup steps.

mongrain.ca
Step 1Add Embed HTML

In the Wix editor: Add › Embed code › Embed HTML. Stretch it to full width.

Step 2Paste the code

Choose “Code”, paste everything from the panel below, then Update.

Step 3Set the height

This page scrolls inside its own frame: set the embed to one screen tall, about 900 px on desktop and 740–800 px on mobile.
